A ride-sharing feature for elevators

questions.n: The hitch is a specialized clamping system that secures the steel cables to the elevator structure.

questions.q: In fire safety, what is a 'Class I' occupant?
o: Professional firefighters trained to use 2.5-inch hoses
A wealthy person living on the top floor
Children in a daycare center
People who work in the building lobby
questions.n: Class I systems and procedures are designed for professional use by emergency services.

questions.q: Which part of a hydraulic elevator is responsible for pushing the car up?
o: The Governor
A steel cable
The Plunger (or Piston)
The Counterweight
questions.n: The plunger is the vertical rod that extends from the cylinder when fluid is pumped into it, lifting the car.

questions.q: What is 'Escalator Tandem Operation'?
o: A pair of escalators where one goes up and one goes down
When an escalator carries two people on every step
Two escalators moving in the same direction side-by-side
Two escalators placed end-to-end to cover a very high rise
questions.n: Tandem or 'In-line' operation involves multiple units placed in a row to transport people across a long vertical or horizontal distance.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a standard trigger for a fire pump to start automatically?
o: A drop in system water pressure
The activation of a remote manual start button
The sound of a dog barking in the lobby
A scheduled weekly timer (for testing)
questions.n: Fire pumps respond to hydraulic and electrical signals, not acoustic ones.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a 'vertical' conveyor system commonly used for passenger transport?
o: Elevator
Moving Walkway
Escalator
Dumbwaiter
questions.n: Elevators are the primary mechanical means for transporting people and goods vertically between building levels.

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of an elevator 'hoistway'?
o: To house the main controller computer
To store the hydraulic fluid
To provide a protected space for the car to travel
To act as a ventilation shaft for the lobby
questions.n: The hoistway is the fire-rated vertical shaft that contains the elevator car, guide rails, and counterweights.

questions.q: Which brand is a well-known manufacturer of elevators and escalators, founded in the United States?
o: Kone
Otis
Mitsubishi
Hitachi
questions.n: Otis is one of the oldest and most prominent American companies in the industry.

questions.q: In a building's fire suppression system, what is the role of a 'smoke detector'?
o: To sense combustion products and trigger an alarm
To spray water on the fire
To provide a physical barrier against flames
To pump water into the standpipe
questions.n: Detectors identify the presence of smoke early to warn occupants and signal the fire alarm system.

questions.q: What color is commonly used on the borders of escalator steps to increase passenger safety?
o: Blue
Yellow
Green
Red
questions.n: Yellow provides high visibility to mark the boundaries of the step and the 'danger zone' near the skirts.

questions.q: Which component is designed to be used manually to put out a small fire in its early stages?
o: Jockey Pump
Firewall
Fire Extinguisher
Siamese Connection
questions.n: Portable extinguishers are the primary tool for occupants to fight small, localized fires.

questions.q: What does the 'cab' refer to in elevator terminology?
o: The weight that balances the car
The motor room on the roof
The passenger compartment of the elevator
The steel cables that pull the car
questions.n: The cab is the internal enclosure where people stand while being transported.

questions.q: A 'wet standpipe' system is different from a 'dry' system because:
o: It requires manual activation by a pump
The pipes are always filled with water
It uses oil instead of water
It is only used for outdoor structures
questions.n: Wet standpipes are constantly pressurized with water for immediate use upon opening a valve.

questions.q: Which of these is a safety device that automatically stops water flow once a fire is extinguished in specialized systems?
o: Check Valve
Sprinkler Head
Smoke Detector
Fire Pump
questions.n: Standard sprinkler heads stay open until the water supply is manually shut off.

questions.q: In terms of building height, which type of elevator is most commonly used for low-rise buildings (2-5 storeys)?
o: High-speed Traction
Bullet Train Elevator
Hydraulic
Double-deck Elevator
questions.n: Hydraulic elevators are the standard choice for low-rise buildings due to lower installation costs.
